Details

The Scarlett Blue Dress is a graceful navy denim mini designed to look as beautiful as it feels. Delicate scalloped edges along the neckline and hem add a soft, feminine charm, while slender shoulder straps enhance its elegant silhouette. Subtle lace-up detailing at the side offers added size flexibility, ensuring a flattering fit. Thoughtfully designed with two removable accessories—a silver bow/flower and a pink accent—this dress lets you personalise your look with ease. Youthful yet timeless, the Scarlett effortlessly transitions from daytime outings to evening occasions, making it a versatile staple every woman can reach for again and again.

Shipping & exchanges

Orders are dispatched within 3–7 business days. Delivery within India usually takes 3–7 business days after that, and you get a tracking link when your order ships. Shipping charges are shown at checkout.

Exchanges are offered for damaged, defective or wrong items reported within 2 days of delivery, unused and in original packaging. Sale items and gift cards can’t be exchanged, and refunds aren’t given as money.
